text:
Situation: Corvale General holds 73 vials of etoposide 20 mg/mL, 25 mL, with current usage of 3 vials per day, providing 24.3 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show etoposide is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is adequate for the near term. Multiple manufacturers are available and none appear on FDA's shortage list today. No allocation or conservation measures are needed at this time.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue standard purchasing from AVYXA Pharma, LLC as the primary source; buyer approves.
2. Maintain Accord Healthcare Inc. and BluePoint Laboratories as qualified alternate sources; buyer approves.
3. Monitor FDA's shortage list weekly for any status change; buyer reports to committee.
4. Reassess inventory and days on hand at the next P&T meeting; committee reviews.

Not recommended: Initiating allocation protocols, seeking emergency allocations, or changing clinical protocols based on supply concerns.
